title: Telefonie Call
description: Represents a voice call made or received through the Telefonie Voice API.

id.description: Unique identifier for the call (UUID format)

direction.description: Whether the call is inbound or outbound

from.description: Originating phone number in E.164 format

to.description: Destination phone number in E.164 format

duration.description: Duration of the call in seconds (available after completion)

start_time.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the call was answered

end_time.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the call ended

price.description: Cost of the call (negative value indicates charge)

price_unit.description: ISO 4217 currency code for the price

recording_url.description: URL to the call recording if the call was recorded

url.description: Webhook URL that was called to control the call flow

status_callback.description: Webhook URL receiving call status change events

answered_by.description: Whether the call was answered by a human or machine (AMD result)
